title: After Being Used by Jaehyuk
description:
Two months since you found out Jaehyuk had used you.
You thought you'd sorted it out.
Today, Jaehyuk contacted you.

choices.result_text:
You didn't pick up.
Being used once had sharpened your judgment.
Being fooled twice is different from being fooled once.

choices.text: Hear what he has to say
choices.result_text:
You listened.
It wasn't an apology.
It was another proposal.
People who use others just change their methods.

title: After Partnering with Jaehyuk
description:
Two months into the partnership with Jaehyuk.
Things were moving along.
Today he asked for your opinion on an important decision.

choices.result_text:
You told him straight.
Jaehyuk paused to think.
"That's a fair point," he said.
For a partnership to mean something, both sides have to be able to be honest.

You left it to him.
He decided.
If you never voice your opinion in a partnership, you end up just going along.

title: After Turning Down Jaehyuk's Offer
description:
Two months since you turned down Jaehyuk's offer.
The relationship had been awkward ever since.
Today you heard news about Jaehyuk through a mutual contact.

choices.result_text:
You couldn't tell whether the deal had worked out or not.
But the feeling that you were right to say no was still there.
Some refusals are right even without a clear outcome.

choices.text: Don't give it a second thought
choices.result_text:
You let it go.
However things turned out on Jaehyuk's side—that's the story after you said no.
A refusal doesn't have to follow what comes next.

title: After Being Scammed by Jaehyuk
description:
Two months since it was confirmed that Jaehyuk had scammed you.
You had looked into legal options.
Today a lawyer got in touch.

choices.result_text:
You followed the proper steps.
It was complicated.
But letting it go could have cost even more in the long run.
Fighting back after being scammed prevents the next scam.

choices.text: Weigh whether it's worth the cost and energy
choices.result_text:
You considered dropping it.
The lawyer said, "This might not be just your problem."
They meant there could be other victims.

title: After Deciding to Be with Jiyeon
description:
Two months since you decided to be together with Jiyeon.
It had felt unfamiliar at first.
Today Jiyeon reached out first.

choices.result_text:
You answered warmly.
Jiyeon said, "Nothing special—have you eaten?"
A casual message like that is what being together actually looks like.

choices.text: Stop asking why she's calling first
choices.result_text:
You just picked up.
Jiyeon laughed. "You always used to ask what was up."
Being together means being able to call for no reason.

title: After Things Ended with Jiyeon
description:
Two months since things fully ended with Jiyeon.
You thought of her sometimes.
Today you passed by a place connected to her.

choices.result_text:
You kept walking.
You didn't stop.
Accepting what you ended as truly over also takes time.

You stopped for a moment.
Then walked on.
Longing and regret are two different things.
What you felt just now was longing.

title: After Jiyeon Called from Gangnam
description:
Two months since Jiyeon reached out to you from Gangnam first.
That message had stayed with you.
Today another message came from her.

choices.result_text:
You picked up.
Jiyeon asked, "Was it okay that I called back then?"
"It was fine," you said.
You'd become the kind of people who could reach out first.

choices.text: Try contacting her first this time
choices.result_text:
You reached out first.
She picked up right away.
Someone who's been the first to receive a call knows how to make one.

title: After Deciding to Be with Daeun
description:
Two months since you decided to be together with Daeun.
It had been a cautious start.
Today Daeun brought up something that was worrying her for the first time.

choices.result_text:
You thought it through with her.
Daeun said, "It's nice doing this kind of thing together."
Being together was confirmed in those few words.

You listened.
Daeun said, "Thanks. I feel better having said it."
Being there doesn't have to mean fixing things.

title: After Things Ended with Daeun
description:
Two months since things ended with Daeun.
It had been a choice you both made.
Today you heard that Daeun seemed happy.

choices.result_text:
You were glad for her.
Genuinely.
When you end things not out of bitterness, the other person's happiness becomes something real to celebrate.

You still felt complicated.
But knowing she was happy—that didn't feel bad.
Complicated feelings and being glad for someone can exist at the same time.

title: After Letting Daeun Go
description:
Two months since you chose to let Daeun go.
It had been your decision.
Today you ran into Daeun by chance.

choices.result_text:
You said hello naturally.
She did too.
Letting go had made this naturalness possible.
If you'd held on by force, there'd be no greeting like this.

choices.text: Make eye contact but walk past
choices.result_text:
You walked past.
It felt like the right call.
Letting go also means being able to pass each other without stopping.

title: After Choosing the Quant Specialization
description:
Three months into the quantitative investment track.
You'd wrestled with the data.
Today your own algorithm worked in a real trade for the first time.

choices.result_text:
It worked.
The feeling when the numbers lined up—not intuition, but logic actually operating.
Choosing the quant path found its meaning in this moment.

You refined it more.
One success doesn't mean the algorithm is finished.
The quant path has no end—that's the nature of the field.

title: After Choosing the Speculator Track
description:
Three months into the speculation track.
Big gains, big losses.
Today you tallied up your results so far.

choices.result_text:
You were in the green.
But the stress had piled up alongside the gains.
Speculation—the results look fine, but the process is a different story.

You were in the red.
Choosing this track meant accepting losses like this.
You should have known what you were accepting when you chose it.

title: After Choosing the Tech Founder Track
description:
Three months into the tech startup track.
You'd built something.
Today someone outside showed up saying they were using it.

choices.result_text:
You met them.
It was the first time you'd seen someone using it rather than building it.
You had a user—the track had finally begun.

You asked how they'd heard about it.
"Just stumbled across it," they said.
Just stumbled across it—that's the most honest answer a first user can give.

title: After Crossing Into Darker Territory
description:
Two months since you crossed a line that wasn't clearly drawn.
The money had come in.
But something nagged at you sometimes.
Today you saw where things were heading.

choices.result_text:
You kept going.
As long as the money comes in—you keep going.
Stopping is usually not a choice. It's an accident.

You stopped.
The unease had made you stop.
Conscience speaks slowly—but it always speaks eventually.

title: After Refusing Dirty Money
description:
Two months since you walked away from big money and turned down a dirty deal.
You still missed that money sometimes.
Today you heard how that deal turned out.

choices.result_text:
It blew up.
If you'd taken that money, you'd have gone down with it.
You were right to say no.
The regret reads differently now.

Maybe it wouldn't have blown up.
You still felt the sting.
But you'd already said no.
You'd already put yourself on the line with that choice.
